text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Unicorn Stakes has finally 
arrived. Shinko Windy is the center of 
attention because of that big incident.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's the rumored "Biting Umamusume"! 
Ahaha, I'm rooting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Windy-chaaan♪ No biting today, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, show us you chomping down on it~! 
That's what we came to see, after all~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha! Gununu, it's completely stuck now...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...It's a bit disgraceful, but everyone is 
looking this way...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —*Ahem*!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Raaaaawr! It's Shinko Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's totally trying to intimidate 
me. Talk about a "wild troublemaker"!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, she doesn't call herself a bad 
Umamusume for nothing~ So that's what a 
'scoundrel' who uses any means necessary 
looks like...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...!!? A r-ruffian!? A coward, you 
sayyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan might be a villain, but not 
like that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to properly apologize to her, 
too! I also promised Trainer that I 
wouldn't do it again.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan doesn't cheat!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Dahahahaha! Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek!! What is their deal?!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even though Windy-chan said, "I won't do 
it anymore"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reaped what I sowed. It's only natural 
that I'll get teased a bit for it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... At this rate, maybe I should 
just go bite their heads off...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no, no! Biting during a race is 
absolutely forbidden!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I can't go biting the other runners 
anymore either, you know.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No matter how badly I want to win, how 
pissed off I get, or how much my teeth 
itch with frustration...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No...! Must endure, must endure...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I believe in you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I'm gonna take all this frustration 
and throw it into the race-noda."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dammit! Just you waaaatch!!
